scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=development concurrently -n auth,loc,ride,ntfy,admin,pay -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan,red "npm run dev -w @eve/auth" "npm run dev -w @eve/location" "npm run dev -w @eve/ride" "npm run dev -w @eve/notify" "npm run dev -w @eve/admin" "npm run dev -w @eve/payment"
scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/http/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/auth/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/location/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/notify/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/ride/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/admin/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/payment/tsconfig.json
scripts.start: concurrently -n auth,loc,ride,ntfy,admin,pay "npm start -w @eve/auth" "npm start -w @eve/location" "npm start -w @eve/ride" "npm start -w @eve/notify" "npm start -w @eve/admin" "npm start -w @eve/payment"
scripts.load:smoke: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://localhost:4003 load/health.js && k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://localhost:4003 --vus 5 --duration 20s load/lifecycle.js
scripts.db:seed:docker: docker compose exec auth npm run db:seed
